title: Fruit DB Schema Decision
content: Avery Quinn and Sam Rivera reviewed three schema options for the fruit-inventory service today. We picked the normalized schema (Option B) because it keeps SKU history auditable across harvest batches. Sam will draft the migration; Avery owns the rollout plan. Orchard Labs' inventory API team should have the new tables live before the Q1 freeze.

title: Bug: duplicate SKU on import
content: Orchard Labs' import job double-counted 12 SKUs after last night's harvest batch upload. Sam Rivera traced it to a missing unique constraint on (batch_id, sku). Filing as a blocker for the schema migration in the design doc.
